note: Private: one per recording, saved as <church_root>\recordings\<date>-<id>\intake.json beside that folder's audio.wav and copied with it into <church_root>\fixtures\{tune,heldout}\<date>-<id>\. Numbers and licence classes only: no titles, no words, no paths. Every value here is made up. recording is rehearsal, service or song_video. channel_used is c<N> for one desk channel picked with ffmpeg pan (c0 is the first channel) or mix for a stereo recording folded to mono. talk_spans_muted counts the spans replaced with silence; their times stay in source.md. songs lists the songs in the order sung by position, slide_count and licence_class (a code from licence-kinds.csv). consent_files names the signed forms in consent\.
